name: KR800
tagline: Modern minimalist pedestal stove with an ultra-wide glass viewing pane
description: The KR800 is a sophisticated pedestal-mounted wood stove featuring a striking, clean square profile designed to anchors modern open-concept spaces. Engineered to efficiently heat extensive residential zones up to 120m², it showcases an oversized glass door panel with integrated black borders that seamlessly frames the firebox inside. Elevating the combustion chamber on a heavy-duty, solid central pedestal base creates a beautiful floating illusion while keeping the focal view right at eye level.
features: Sleek architectural pedestal design raising the firebox to an optimal viewing level
Large format front glass fascia with polished black accents for a contemporary look
Powerful heating capacity custom-engineered for extensive areas up to 120 square meters
Premium internal combustion chamber insulation maximizing steady thermal radiation
Sleek vertical metallic door handle providing smooth, airtight tactile operation
